interpretation: In this N=8,K=4,A=4 comparator, all-to-all matching reaches entropy close to the symmetry-sector Page mean at fewer layers than the local brickwork chain.

The brickwork first layer has zero entropy growth for this particular product cut because its first even-bond matching acts within the two four-qubit halves; the next odd layer introduces cross-cut interactions.

At depth 24 the mean entropy gap is about 0.1274 nats for brickwork and 0.00368 nats for all-to-all, but the small finite sample and one initial state do not establish a universal topology ranking or a rigorous mixing time.
Individual samples can exceed the Page ensemble mean; only the ensemble statistics should be compared with its uncertainty.
